sources.label: Android Auto patches for Morphe: show sideloaded car apps without installer tric
sources.author: Gearhead
patch_list: Makes Android Auto treat every app as installed from the Google Play Store, so sideloaded Android Auto apps show up in the car launcher without an installer app, developer settings or the "Unknown sources" setting.
